steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. Silverado and Sierra 1500 pickups built before the 2022.5 refresh tune on EZ LYNK or HP Tuners. Big centre screen in the dash? That is a 2022.5 or newer truck, so call or text (250) 261-9502 before you order.

options.name: EZ LYNK Custom Tuning
options.note: Pickups only. Choose your support pack and transmission tuning.

options.name: HP Tuners Custom Tuning
options.note: Pickups only. Choose your level, credits and transmission tuning.

options.name: HP Tuners Custom Tuning, SUV
options.note: 2021-2024 Tahoe, Suburban, Yukon and Escalade. Needs an HP Tuners send-in unlock.

steps.title: Tuning Device
steps.text: The device loads your tune onto the truck. Already have one? Skip this step. Match it to your tune.

steps.title: CAN Bus Plugs
steps.text: AMDP needs CAN bus plugs fitted to tune this engine, so we added them for you. Remove them if your truck already has them.

steps.title: Delete Pipe
steps.text: The pipe that replaces the factory DPF section. Optional.

steps.title: EGR
steps.text: EGR kit. Optional. Skip it if you don't need it.
